title: Prerequisites and how to rock this course

cues.en: I want to say a few words about how best to succeed from this course.
cues.zh: 我想先談談，如何在這門課獲得最佳學習成果。

cues.en: I hope this video helps you decide whether this course is right for you, and I hope this helps you
cues.zh: 希望這支影片能幫你判斷課程是否適合，也希望能幫助你，

cues.en: structure your learning to get the most from your experience in this course.
cues.zh: 安排學習方式，從這門課獲得最多收穫。

cues.en: Now, there are three kinds of material in this course traditional lectures where you'll learn about theory and proofs and reasoning and so on.
cues.zh: 課程有三種內容：傳統講課，學習理論、證明、推理等。

cues.en: This is basically the same as traditional lectures you would have at an in-person course in a high school or university.
cues.zh: 基本上和高中或大學實體課程的傳統講課相同。

cues.en: I strongly recommend that you take notes during these lectures.
cues.zh: 我強烈建議聽這些課時做筆記。

cues.en: I don't make my slides available, but you have lifetime access to this course so you can always come back to it for review.
cues.zh: 我不提供投影片，但你能終身存取課程，所以隨時可以回來複習。

cues.en: Almost every video contains exercises that will allow you to practice the material that I am explaining.
cues.zh: 幾乎每支影片都有練習，讓你實作我所解釋的內容。

cues.en: I will tell you when to pause the video to solve these exercises on your own, on paper with a pencil.
cues.zh: 我會告訴你何時暫停，用紙筆自行解題。

cues.en: And then I will go through the answer in the lecture.
cues.zh: 然後在課堂上講解答案。

cues.en: So you pause the video, solve the problems on your own, then unpause the video to see the answer, and also to hear my detailed explanation of why the answer is what it is.
cues.zh: 所以先暫停、自行解題，再繼續播放，看看答案，也聽我詳細解釋為什麼是這個答案。

cues.en: And I also try to point out common mistakes or tricks that you can benefit from.
cues.zh: 我也會試著指出常見錯誤，或能幫助你的技巧。

cues.en: And this course also contains lots and lots of code challenges.
cues.zh: 這門課還有非常多程式挑戰。

cues.en: These are slightly longer assignments that involve solving problems, using a combination of reasoning
cues.zh: 這些作業稍長，需要結合推理，

cues.en: and calculus and python coding In these code challenges.
cues.zh: 微積分與 Python 程式來解題。在程式挑戰中，

cues.en: I will tell you when to pause the video so you can work through the exercises on your own, but most
cues.zh: 我會告訴你何時暫停，自行完成練習；不過影片大部分時間，

cues.en: of the time during the recording is actually me explaining my code and how the code implements the calculus concepts.
cues.zh: 都是我解釋程式碼，以及程式如何實作微積分概念。

cues.en: Now I'm also going to talk more about the coding aspects of this course in the first video of the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節第一支影片，還會進一步介紹本課程的程式部分。

cues.en: This course has a Q&A section, which is awesome.
cues.zh: 課程也有問答區，非常棒。

cues.en: It's something that I really love about the Udemy platform.
cues.zh: 這是我很喜歡 Udemy 平台的一點。

cues.en: In the next video, I'm going to explain how to use the Q&A, but if you come up with a really interesting
cues.zh: 下一支會說明如何使用問答區；如果你針對程式挑戰想出非常有趣的，

cues.en: solution to the code challenges, then please feel free to post your amazing creative solutions and your insights into the Q&A.
cues.zh: 解法，歡迎把精彩又有創意的解法與心得貼到問答區。

cues.en: This is a really great way to contribute back to the course because it creates this repository for other students to benefit and learn from each other.
cues.zh: 這是回饋課程的好方式，因為能累積資源，讓其他學生受益、彼此學習。

cues.en: Let's talk about prerequisites.
cues.zh: 談談先備知識。

cues.en: I have tried to make this course comprehensive and approachable to anyone with basic high school math skills.
cues.zh: 我試著讓課程完整，也讓任何具備基本高中數學能力的人都能理解。

cues.en: On the other hand, it's simply impossible to make the course ideally customized for every learner.
cues.zh: 但另一方面，不可能為每一位學習者都做出完美客製化的課程。

cues.en: So it is possible that you might have to look up something online.
cues.zh: 所以有些東西，你可能得上網查。

cues.en: Obviously, you don't need to know any calculus.
cues.zh: 顯然不需要先懂微積分。

cues.en: That's why you're here now.
cues.zh: 這正是你來這裡的原因。

cues.en: You do need some python knowledge for this course.
cues.zh: 這門課需要一些 Python 知識。

cues.en: If you are new to Python, you can go through the tutorial, the python tutorial.
cues.zh: 如果剛接觸 Python，可以先看 Python 教學，

cues.en: At the end of this course I will have more to say about that tutorial in lecture six.
cues.zh: 就在本課程最後；第六堂會再介紹那個教學。

cues.en: Now to be clear, you can follow along this course without ever writing a single line of code.
cues.zh: 說清楚一點，你就算完全不寫程式，也能跟上課程。

cues.en: And that's great.
cues.zh: 這也很好。

cues.en: You're still going to learn a lot of calculus, but to get the full educational value of this course, I really do encourage you to get your hands wet with Python.
cues.zh: 仍然會學到很多微積分，但為了獲得完整的教育價值，我真的鼓勵你動手用 Python。

cues.en: All of that said, to be honest, the most important prerequisite is having an intention.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，坦白說，最重要的先備條件，是抱持明確的學習意圖。

cues.en: What does this mean?
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思？

cues.en: This means that, well, it means that you have to know why you're taking this course.
cues.zh: 就是要知道自己為什麼修這門課。

cues.en: Why do you want to learn calculus?
cues.zh: 為什麼想學微積分？

cues.en: I have tried to make this course as approachable and useful as possible, but still it takes some effort, some motivation and some diligence on your part to learn math.
cues.zh: 我已盡量讓課程容易理解、實用，但學數學仍需要你付出努力、動機和勤奮。

cues.en: So if you're good for this, if you're comfortable that you have an intention for why you want to take this course, then don't worry about all this other stuff.
cues.zh: 所以如果這點沒問題，你清楚知道自己為什麼要上這門課，就別擔心其他事情。

cues.en: This will work itself out.
cues.zh: 其他自然會逐步解決。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I want to say a few final notes about this course and some tips to share with you.
cues.zh: 最後再談幾點課程說明，以及一些建議。

cues.en: Now, I print out all of the equations in this course using latex and not writing them out by hand during the video.
cues.zh: 本課程所有公式都用 LaTeX 排版，不會在錄影時手寫。

cues.en: That is a major departure from traditional calculus courses.
cues.zh: 這和傳統微積分課有很大差異。

cues.en: But, you know, this is not a traditional calculus course.
cues.zh: 不過，這本來就不是傳統微積分課。

cues.en: This is a modern calculus course.
cues.zh: 這是現代微積分課程。

cues.en: And I am a big believer in trying out new ways to teach important concepts like calculus.
cues.zh: 我非常相信，應該嘗試新的方式，教授微積分這類重要概念。

cues.en: Anyway, there is a huge source of confusion and difficulty and frustration and wasted time in calculus courses by trying to decipher the instructor.
cues.zh: 在微積分課裡，試圖辨認講師，

cues.en: Sloppy handwriting.
cues.zh: 潦草的字跡，是造成困惑、困難、挫折和浪費時間的一大來源。

cues.en: So Logitech printed code is clean.
cues.zh: 所以 LaTeX 排版的內容很乾淨。

cues.en: It's neat.
cues.zh: 整齊。

cues.en: It is clear, it's easy to read.
cues.zh: 清晰，而且容易閱讀。

cues.en: And of course, you can pause the video whenever you want.
cues.zh: 當然，隨時都能暫停影片。

cues.en: I've already mentioned that I encourage you to take notes on by hand on paper or e paper, but not by typing on your laptop.
cues.zh: 剛才已說，我鼓勵在紙上或電子紙手寫筆記，不要在筆電打字。

cues.en: This is based on a ton of scientific research that shows that comprehension.
cues.zh: 這是根據大量科學研究，研究顯示理解，

cues.en: So learning is deeper and memory is better when you take notes by hand instead of using slide handouts and or taking notes on your laptop.
cues.zh: 也就是學習，會更深入，記憶也更好，相較於使用投影片講義，或在筆電打字做筆記。

cues.en: I'm a scientist and I follow the data and this is what the data say Now, because this is an online course, you should feel free to adjust the video speed.
cues.zh: 我是科學家，依資料行事，資料就是這樣顯示的。因為這是線上課程，可以自由調整播放速度。

cues.en: You can speed up the videos if you're already familiar with the topics, or you can slow down the videos
cues.zh: 如果已熟悉主題，可以加速；也能放慢影片，

cues.en: if you want to take more detailed notes or if English isn't your native language.
cues.zh: 如果想做更詳細的筆記，或英文不是母語。

cues.en: Now a little bit more about the coding videos.
cues.zh: 再多談一點程式影片。

cues.en: Even if you can solve the coding challenges completely on your own, the solutions are not just me presenting
cues.zh: 即使能完全自行解決程式挑戰，解答影片也不只是呈現，

cues.en: code, but instead it's me discussing calculus concepts in more detail and also implementations on computers.
cues.zh: 程式碼，而是更詳細討論微積分概念，以及電腦上的實作。

cues.en: So I do recommend watching the full coding videos.
cues.zh: 所以我建議完整看完程式影片。

cues.en: Finally, and most important on this list, and also related to the idea of setting an intention from the previous slide, you need to be an active learner.
cues.zh: 最後，也是這份清單最重要的，和前張投影片的設定意圖有關：你必須主動學習。

cues.en: Pause the video, often solve the exercises, work through the proofs on your own.
cues.zh: 經常暫停、解練習、自己走過證明。

cues.en: If you can't get a solution, then just make sure you're putting some effort into it.
cues.zh: 如果解不出來，至少要確實投入一些努力。

cues.en: Every little piece of effort you put into being an active learner is time invested.
cues.zh: 為了主動學習付出的每一點努力，都是時間投資。

cues.en: I promise all of that hard work will pay off at the end.
cues.zh: 我保證，這些努力最終都會有回報。

cues.en: Well, that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 好，這支影片就到這裡。

cues.en: I hope that you are super duper mega excited for this course.
cues.zh: 希望你對這門課充滿超級無敵的期待。
